module.description: Plan and implement a Cresko module from migration through tests.
module.template: Implement the requested Cresko module: $ARGUMENTS. Start by inspecting the repository and load the relevant skills. Define the migration first, then API, UI, and tests. Keep the change minimal and report verification.

migration.description: Design a migration with RLS and tenant isolation.
migration.template: Design the Supabase migration for: $ARGUMENTS. Include constraints, indexes, RLS policies, and tenant-isolation tests or verification notes. Do not implement API behavior.

pos-check.description: Review POS barcode, cache, stock, and checkout invariants.
pos-check.template: Review the current POS implementation for: barcode input, catalog cache, authorization, currency, stock concurrency, and atomic checkout. Report findings with file and line references.
